subject: Re: Kickoff: C-Learning - decision: guardrail in, unconditional OPE claims out
body:
All,

Sweep results reviewed with Jelena this morning. Decisions:

1) The ablation confirms the theory-driven goal-sampling ratio: the predicted optimum was within one grid step of the empirical best on all 6 tasks. That's the headline for the M3 spec and it's a clean story - "principled, not folklore".

2) On off-policy evaluation: Halima's trust-radius data settles it. The integration spec ships WITH the policy-divergence guardrail - OPE results outside the trusted region get flagged, not reported. I'm cutting the "evaluate any policy, zero new data" phrasing from the customer-facing material; it becomes "evaluate nearby policies without new data collection", which the 18-point miss makes non-negotiable.

3) Scope cut: the image-observation variant moves out of this window entirely. State-based observations only for M3 on Jul 24.

Oyin, please have the spec skeleton to Halima by Friday.

Thanks all - the reserved week paid for itself.

Ulla
